title: 36 Stocks To Watch After Biden's First State of The Union Address
description:
President Joe Biden hosted his first State of the Union Address Tuesday in front of members of Congress. In the speech, Biden discussed several items that he has already helped pass along with more future initiatives.
Here is a look at stocks to watch after the State of the Union address.
Pharmaceutical Companies: In 2016, then- Vice President Biden launched the Cancer Moonshot program the help boost spending on medical research to take on various types of cancer.
In 2022, Biden announced plans to boost spending and reduce the death rate from cancer by 50% over the next 25 years.
The Partnership for Accelerating Cancer Therapies includes 11 companies working to boost treatments for various types of cancers. The companies are AbbVie Inc (NYSE: ABBV), Amgen Inc (NASDAQ: AMGN), Boehringer-Ingelheim Pharma, Bristol-Myers Squibb Co (NYSE: BMY), Celgene (owned by Bristol-Myers Squibb), Genetech (owned by Roche), Gilead Sciences (NASDAQ: GILD), GlaxoSmithKline (NYSE: GSK), Janssen Research (owned by Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ)), Novartis (NYSE: NVS), Sanofi SA (NASDAQ: SNY) and Pfizer Inc (NYSE: PFE).
Biden announced his Unity Agenda, which included ending cancer as we know it as one of four bipartisan issues that can be passed.
Social Media: Biden took aim at social media platforms and the data collected from children.
“It’s time to strengthen privacy protections, ban targeted advertising to children, and demand tech companies stop collecting personal data on our children.”
The comment could be aimed at companies like Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: FB) and Twitter Inc (NYSE: TWTR). A push to change data collection and advertising could hurt advertising revenue down the road for the companies.

title: Stocks Retreat, Nasdaq Hits 4-Week Low, Energy Sector Rallies: What's Driving Markets Wednesday?
description:
U.S. stocks continue their downward trajectory on Wednesday, failing to reverse their negative momentum, as investors approach Thursday’s inflation data release with caution. 
The Nasdaq 100 briefly touched its lowest point since July 11, experiencing a 1% drop as of midday trading. 
Reviving concerns about inflation is the recent surge in energy prices. WTI crude oil has surged back to $83 per barrel, marking its highest level since November 2022, while natural gas surged by over 6%, hitting its highest level since the end of January 2023.

title: Axon's Growth Can't Be Stopped
description: Axon's business is expanding rapidly, with the company not only gaining new law enforcement agency customers but also introducing new products. The article discusses whether Axon's growth is worth the current stock price.

title: 2 Stocks I Recently Sold, Even Though I Love These Businesses
description: The article discusses why the author sold Axon Enterprise and United Rentals despite them being excellent businesses, citing valid reasons for hitting the sell button even when a stock's price has gone up.

title: Why Axon Enterprise Shares Jumped in August
description: Axon Enterprise, a provider of hardware and software primarily to law enforcement agencies, reported strong Q2 results with a 35% year-over-year revenue increase. The company's cloud business, which is more profitable, matched its hardware sales for the first time. However, Axon's shares are trading at a high valuation, and investors should consider dollar-cost averaging before buying in.

title: Global Body-Worn Camera Market Size To Worth USD 27.65 Billion By 2033 | CAGR Of 13.97%
description: The global body-worn camera market is expected to grow from $7.48 billion in 2023 to $27.65 billion by 2033, at a CAGR of 13.97%. The market is driven by increased transparency and accountability, particularly in law enforcement, and the growing need for real-time situational awareness and improved decision-making.

title: Why Axon Enterprise Stock Popped 5% Today
description: Axon Enterprise stock jumped 5% after analysts at JMP Securities and Baird raised their price targets on the stock, citing strong growth in the company's core Taser, body camera, and software businesses, including its artificial intelligence software tools.

title: 2 Magnificent Growth Stocks Just Upgraded by Wall Street Analysts to Buy Now
description: Shopify and Axon Enterprise, two leading companies in their respective industries, have recently seen their price targets raised by Wall Street analysts. Shopify is a recognized leader in digital commerce software, while Axon Enterprise dominates the market for conducted energy devices and body cameras.

description: Axon Enterprise, a law enforcement technology company, reported strong financial results for Q3 2024, with revenue up 32% year-over-year and adjusted EBITDA up 54%. The company's recurring revenue and contracted revenue also showed impressive growth, suggesting continued strong performance in the coming years.

title: 4 Amazing but Expensive Stocks to Buy When They Crash
description: The article discusses four expensive but amazing stocks to buy when they crash, including Axon Enterprise and Shopify. It provides investment advice and analysis from The Motley Fool.

title: Meet the Newest Stock in the Nasdaq-100. It's Soared 110,600% Since Its IPO and It's Still a Buy Heading Into 2025, According to Wall Street.
description: Axon Enterprise, a specialty technology company known for its Taser stun guns and law enforcement-supporting technology, has been added to the Nasdaq-100 index. The stock has soared 110,600% since its IPO in 2001 and is still considered a buy by Wall Street analysts, who cite the company's growing suite of products and services, expanding addressable market, and consistent execution.

title: These Are the 5 Top-Performing Stocks in the S&P 500 With 2024 Almost Over
description: The article discusses the top 5 performing stocks of 2024, which were companies benefiting from the growth in artificial intelligence (AI). The stocks mentioned include Palantir Technologies, Vistra, Nvidia, GE Vernova, and Axon Enterprise.
